bullets.text: The State government has ordered civic agencies to complete flood mitigation work in Chennai and suburban districts by October 15, and the office should monitor progress.
Southern Railway wants 43 Tasmac liquor shops near Chennai railway stations relocated due to public safety hazards, and the office should coordinate with departments on action.
Residents in Velachery continue to face severe travel delays due to ongoing Metrowater work on the Velachery-Tambaram road, and the office should push for speedier execution.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has completed nearly 95 percent of its storm water drain network, and the office should verify readiness before the monsoon arrives.
Avadi Village Administrative Officer and an assistant were arrested for taking an 8,000 rupee bribe to issue a legal heir certificate, and the office should demand strict administrative checks.
Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu expressed concern over poor road infrastructure at the Ambattur industrial estate, and the office should engage with stakeholders to address the issues.
Fishermen from Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh agreed to use GPS demarcation to resolve Pulicat Lake disputes, and the office should support formal implementation.
Starbucks is establishing its first India Global Capability Centre in Chennai to create 800 jobs, and the office should assist with facilitation.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has planned a ₹98.25 crore upgrade for its Integrated Command and Control Centre, and the office should oversee its deployment.
Omnicom Group launched its GCC facility in Coimbatore, reinforcing Tamil Nadu's tech footprint, and the office should track state-wide expansion trends.
The TVK government rolled back key announcements following public opposition, and the office should monitor policy stability.
Minister Raj Mohan stated that changing the election commissioner is not a solution, and the office should note political reactions.
The government launched a scheme providing gold rings to newborns in Chennai government hospitals, and the office should promote awareness of the initiative.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Chennai on October 11 to launch metro rail services, and the office should coordinate administrative preparations.
